Yes, in the vitest 5.0.3 you have installed. Inline projects in `test.projects` now inherit every option from the root config by default, because `extends` defaults to `true`. I checked this against the installed type definitions (`node_modules/vitest/dist/chunks/plugin.d.BsjqSb4-.d.ts:4499-4507`), which document `extends?: string | boolean` with `@default true`.

This is a silent change from Vitest 3/4. There, an inline project inherited nothing unless you set `extends: true`, so older configs may now pick up root options you didn't expect. To keep a project fully separate, set `extends: false`. You can also set `extends` to a path, such as `'../vite.config.ts'`, to merge the project with that config instead.
